commands.name: AppLogsAnalysisClean
commands.description: Gather Cloud Foundry application state, recent events, and recent logs for an app, and start it if stopped. No AI Core dependency.

resourceGroup.description: Resource group for the Cloud Foundry space

resourceName.description: Name of the Cloud Foundry application

region.description: Region of the Cloud Foundry instance

subAccount.description: Sub-account for the Cloud Foundry organization

appLogs.description: Recent application log entries (parsed JSON objects) for the app from SAP Cloud ALM.

input.message: $(.getCfOrgQuota.output.body | toObject | .apps.total_memory_in_mb | if . == null or . == 0 then 0 else (($.getCfSpaceUsage.output.body | toObject | .usage_summary.memory_in_mb | toNumber) / ($.getCfOrgQuota.output.body | toObject | .apps.total_memory_in_mb | toNumber) * 10000 | round | . / 100) end)

$(.getCfOrgQuota.output.body | toObject | .apps.total_memory_in_mb | if . == null or . == 0 then 0 else (($.getCfOrgUsage.output.body | toObject | .usage_summary.memory_in_mb | toNumber) / ($.getCfOrgQuota.output.body | toObject | .apps.total_memory_in_mb | toNumber) * 10000 | round | . / 100 ) end)

commands.name: CheckResourceQuotaUtilizationClean
commands.description: Calculate resource utilization of Cloud Foundry space and its parrent organization

spaceId.description: The GUID identifier of the Cloud Foundry space

region.description: Technical name of your SAP BTP region, e.g. cf-eu10,cf-eu20

user.description: User ID or email of a Cloud Foundry technical user

identityProvider.description: Identity provider to be used  By default it is SAP ID Service (sap.ids). To use a custom IdP, enter origin key from the CF Org/Space members section.

spaceMemoryUsedMb.description: Absolute memory in MB currently used by the space.

orgMemoryUsedMb.description: Absolute memory in MB currently used across the whole organization.

orgMemoryQuotaMb.description: Total memory quota in MB allocated to the organization.

spaceMemoryQuotaMb.description: Total memory quota in MB allocated to the space (0 if the space inherits the org quota).

commands.name: CheckResourceUtilization
commands.description: Calculate the resource (memory) utilization of a Cloud Foundry space and its parent organization. Returns the percentage of the memory quota used at both space and org level, so you can judge whether the environment is close to its limits. Credentials are injected automatically.

spaceId.description: GUID of the Cloud Foundry space whose utilization should be calculated.

password.description: Password of the SAP BTP account.

region.description: Technical SAP BTP region. Defaults to cf-eu10-005.

user.description: User id / email of the SAP BTP account.

spaceName.description: Display name of the Cloud Foundry space.

spaceMemoryPercentage.description: Percentage of the space's memory quota currently in use.

spaceMemoryUsedMb.description: Absolute memory in MB currently used by the space.

orgMemoryUsedMb.description: Absolute memory in MB currently used across the whole organization.

orgMemoryQuotaMb.description: Total memory quota in MB allocated to the organization.

spaceMemoryQuotaMb.description: Total memory quota in MB allocated to the space (0 if it inherits the org quota).

orgMemoryPercentage.description: Percentage of the organization's memory quota currently in use.

commands.name: GetAppAllocatedMemory
commands.description: Report the total memory currently allocated (reserved) for a Cloud Foundry application: its per-instance memory, number of running instances, and the resulting total (per-instance memory x instances). Use this to see how much memory an app holds before deciding whether to scale it up. Credentials are injected automatically.

resourceGroup.description: Name or GUID of the Cloud Foundry space the app runs in. Defaults to 'prod'.

password.description: Password of the SAP BTP account.

resourceName.description: Name of the Cloud Foundry application. Defaults to 'bookshop-srv'.

region.description: Technical SAP BTP region. Defaults to cf-eu10-005.

user.description: User id / email of the SAP BTP account.

subAccount.description: Name or GUID of the Cloud Foundry organization the app runs in.

identityProvider.description: Identity provider origin key. Defaults to sap.ids.

desiredState.description: Desired state of the application (e.g. STARTED, STOPPED).

totalAllocatedMb.description: Total memory allocated for the app = per-instance memory x instance count, in MB.

memoryPerInstanceMb.description: Memory allocated per instance, in MB.

commands.name: GetAppLogsAnalysis
commands.description: Get an AI-assisted analysis of the bookshop-srv Cloud Foundry application: its current state, recent application events, and an analysis of its recent logs. Use this to understand how the application is behaving and whether it shows signs of trouble. Credentials and target environment are injected automatically.

resourceGroup.description: Cloud Foundry space the application runs in. Defaults to 'prod'.

password.description: Password of the SAP BTP account.

resourceName.description: Name of the Cloud Foundry application to analyze. Defaults to 'bookshop-srv'.

region.description: Technical SAP BTP region. Defaults to cf-eu10-005.

user.description: User id / email of the SAP BTP account.

subAccount.description: SAP BTP subaccount / Cloud Foundry organization.

identityProvider.description: Identity provider origin key. Defaults to sap.ids.

appLogs.description: Recent application logs from SAP Cloud ALM.

commands.name: GetAppMemoryTrend
commands.description: Report the recent memory-usage trend for the bookshop-srv application by reading its 'Memory status' log lines from SAP Cloud Logging over the last 15 minutes and extracting the RSS (resident memory) values. Returns the latest, minimum, maximum and average RSS in MB, plus the number of samples, so you can judge whether memory is climbing toward its limit. Requires no query input.

serviceKey.description: Service key (JSON credentials) for the SAP Cloud Logging instance.

sampleCount.description: Number of memory-status samples found in the window.

rssMinMb.description: Minimum RSS in MB over the window.

rssMaxMb.description: Maximum RSS in MB over the window.

rssLatestMb.description: Most recent RSS (resident memory) in MB.

rssAvgMb.description: Average RSS in MB over the window.

commands.name: GetCloudLoggingErrors
commands.description: Retrieve recent application error log entries (level=error) for the bookshop-srv application from SAP Cloud Logging, over the last 15 minutes. Returns application-level errors such as 'Book ID ... not found', so you can see what is failing in the running app. Requires no query input - the error filter is built in.

serviceKey.description: Service key (JSON credentials) for the SAP Cloud Logging instance.

hits.description: The matching log entries (bookshop-srv application errors with level=error in the last 15 minutes).

total.description: Total number of matching error log entries in the time range.

count.description: Number of matching error log entries returned.

commands.name: GetCloudLoggingMemory
commands.description: Retrieve recent application memory-status log lines for the bookshop-srv application from SAP Cloud Logging, over the last 15 minutes. Returns the Node.js 'Memory status' entries (RSS, Heap, Buffer) emitted by the running app, so you can judge whether the application is under memory pressure. Requires no query input - the memory-status filter is built in.

serviceKey.description: Service key (JSON credentials) for the SAP Cloud Logging instance.

hits.description: The matching memory-status log entries (bookshop-srv, APP/PROC/WEB, 'Memory status' messages in the last 15 minutes).

total.description: Total number of matching memory-status log entries in the time range.

count.description: Number of matching memory-status log entries returned.

commands.name: ListApps
commands.description: List all Cloud Foundry applications running in a given space. Use this as the starting point of an investigation to discover which apps exist before drilling into a specific one. Returns the app names and a total count.

resourceGroup.description: Name or GUID of the Cloud Foundry space. Defaults to 'prod'.

password.description: Password of the SAP BTP account.

region.description: Technical SAP BTP region. Defaults to cf-eu10-005.

user.description: User id / email of the SAP BTP account.

subAccount.description: Name or GUID of the Cloud Foundry organization.

identityProvider.description: Identity provider origin key. Defaults to sap.ids.

appCount.description: Total number of applications in the space.

appState.description: Desired state of the application (e.g. STARTED, STOPPED).

appNames.description: List of application names in the space.

appNamesText.description: Comma-separated list of application names (reliable string form).

commands.name: UpscaleApp
commands.description: Scale up the bookshop-srv Cloud Foundry application by increasing its allocated memory, then restart it. Use this to remediate an application that is under memory pressure (for example after a health check shows high memory usage). Credentials and target environment are injected automatically.

resourceGroup.description: Cloud Foundry space the application runs in. Defaults to 'prod'.

password.description: Password of the SAP BTP account.

resourceName.description: Name of the Cloud Foundry application to scale. Defaults to 'bookshop-srv'.

region.description: Technical SAP BTP region. Defaults to cf-eu10-005.

user.description: User id / email of the SAP BTP account used to scale the application.

memoryIncrement.description: Amount of memory in MB to add to the application's current per-instance memory. Defaults to 256.

subAccount.description: SAP BTP subaccount / Cloud Foundry organization.

identityProvider.description: Identity provider origin key. Defaults to sap.ids.

instancesRunning.description: Number of instances in RUNNING state after restart.

restartSummary.description: Summary of the restart that applied the new memory.

instancesTotal.description: Total number of application instances after restart.

commands.name: UpscaleAppClean
commands.description: Scale up a Cloud Foundry application's memory by 256 MB and restart it to apply the change. All-v3; no external catalog input dependencies.

resourceGroup.description: Technical name of a Cloud Foundry Space, e.g.: my-space-demo-1

resourceName.description: Technical name of a Cloud Foundry application, e.g.: my-app

region.description: Technical name of a Cloud Foundry region (as defined in CfRegionData), e.g. cf-eu10, cf-br10, etc.

user.description: UserID/Email of the Cloud Foundry user which will be used for authentication

memoryIncrement.description: Amount of memory in MB to add to the application's current per-instance memory. Defaults to 256.

subAccount.description: Technical name of a Cloud Foundry Organization, e.g.: my-org-name-1

identityProvider.description: Identity provider origin key. Defaults to sap.ids.

instancesRunning.description: Number of instances in RUNNING state after restart.

restartSummary.description: Summary of the restart that applied the new memory.

instancesTotal.description: Total number of application instances after restart.
